entities.summary: Mark Randall Volman was an American vocalist, guitarist and songwriter who was best known as a founding member of the 1960s rock band the Turtles. With his bandmate and friend Howard Kaylan, he was a member of the 1970s rock duo Flo & Eddie, in which he used the pseudonym Flo. Volman later joined Frank Zappa's band The Mothers of Invention.
